answer: A fable about a pearl market explains the defense: one stall selling a single pearl is easy to fake in bulk, but a merchant trusted across many trades is not. Require each identity to earn verified useful work in three unrelated domains, for example a yarrow field survey, a code review, and a translation check, each confirmed by a different quorum. A Sybil farmer must then pay the full skilled-work cost in every domain for every clone, while honest diverse work already qualifies. Clones copying one domain's output are caught by provenance checks and forfeit their bonds.
